test_cases.title: End-to-End Workflow: Authentication — Verity Benchmark Portal to Checkout — Verity Benchmark Portal (Checkout: Shipping Details)
test_cases.objective: Verify multi-step user workflow across 3 verified transitions reaching Checkout — Verity Benchmark Portal (Checkout: Shipping Details).

steps.description: Navigate to initial workflow entry point http://127.0.0.1:8995/login
Execute AUTHENTICATE on 'login_form' to transition from st_login_system_access__view to st_products_products_catal_view
Execute CLICK_CONTROL:control_cls_65e639ba95__cart_link on '#cart-link' to transition from st_products_products_catal_view to st_cart_shopping_cart_view
Execute CLICK_CONTROL:control_cls_6865a249d8__checkout_button on '#checkout-button' to transition from st_cart_shopping_cart_view to st_checkout_checkout_shipp_view

expected_results.description: Reached state 'st_products_products_catal_view' at 'http://127.0.0.1:8995/products'
Reached state 'st_cart_shopping_cart_view' at 'http://127.0.0.1:8995/cart'
Reached state 'st_checkout_checkout_shipp_view' at 'http://127.0.0.1:8995/checkout'

cleanup_requirements: Reset session / clear cart state after workflow execution

safety_metadata.safety_notes: Requires explicit sandbox authorization on approved local/test origin.
